2608.21059.title: The Cost of a Physics Prior Is Bounded by the Ablation Gap
2608.21059.paper_summary: Shape-constrained and physics-informed learning reports an accuracy cost of enforcing a prior and treats it as a property of the prior. We show it is mostly a property of the free features and the validation split. Let P be the excess risk of restricting a hypothesis class to functions with a shape constraint on features S, and D the excess risk of the ablated model that ignores S. Because a function constant in x_j is both non-decreasing and non-increasing in x_j, the ablated class is contained in the constrained class, so 0 <= P <= D for every risk functional, with no convexity, smoothness, or realizability assumption. Empirically the bound is a sign test: a constrained model must never be beaten by its own ablation. We instantiate it on an ordinal wildfire-severity task (N = 26,681, K = 3) with hard monotone constraints on four meteorological drivers, coordinates left free, and a validation ladder from i.i.d. resampling to 2-degree spatial blocking. Coordinates act as a shield: alone they recover 92.9% of the full model's macro-F1 under spatial blocking, collapsing D from 0.1288 to 0.0427; the same prior costs 0.0473 shielded and 0.3470 unshielded, a ratio of 7.3 with identical physics. Because D is protocol-dependent it does not transfer: coarsening blocks from 1 to 10 degrees drives D from 0.0942 to 0.0050, leaving two configurations unidentifiable a priori. Inversions of the certified nesting bound the pipeline's additive resolution: over 318 comparisons they give a self-calibrating floor of 0.0220 macro-F1, below which no reported price is interpretable, including four cells in our own headline grid. Cost and compliance are independent: the unconstrained model violates the prior at rate 0.48-0.49 while enforcing it costs 0.0473. We give a two-fit screen that rejects unidentifiable experiments before a constrained model is trained.
2608.21059.paper_summary_zh: 形狀約束和物理知識學習報告了強制先驗的準確性成本，並將其視為先驗的一個性質。我們表明這主要是自由特徵和驗證拆分的性質。設 P 為將假設類限制為具有特徵 S 的形狀約束的函數的過度風險，D 為忽略 S 的消融模型的過度風險。因為在 x_j 中恆定的函數在 x_j 中既是非遞減的又是非遞增的，所以消融類包含在約束類中，因此對於每個風險泛函都有 0 <= P <= D，且不需要凸性、平滑性或可實現性假設。從經驗上看，這個界限是一個符號檢驗：一個受約束的模型永遠不應被其自身的消融所超越。我們在一個有序的野火嚴重性任務（N = 26,681，K = 3）上實現了它，對四個氣象驅動因素施加了嚴格的單調約束，坐標保持自由，並從獨立同分佈重抽樣到 2 度空間阻塞的驗證階梯。坐標充當了一個屏障：單獨使用時，它們在空間阻塞下恢復了完整模型的 92.9% 的宏觀 F1，將 D 從 0.1288 降至 0.0427；相同的先驗在有屏障時的成本為 0.0473，無屏障時為 0.3470，兩者的比率為 7.3，物理條件相同。因為 D 依賴於協議，所以它不會轉移：從 1 到 10 度的粗化阻塞使 D 從 0.0942 降至 0.0050，留下兩個配置在先驗上無法識別。經過認證的嵌套界限反轉了管道的加法分辨率：在 318 次比較中，它們提供了一個自我校準的宏觀 F1 最低值 0.0220，低於此值的報告價格不可解釋，包括我們自己標題網格中的四個單元。成本和合規性是獨立的：無約束模型以 0.48-0.49 的速率違反先驗，而強制執行的成本為 0.0473。我們提供了一個兩次擬合的篩選，拒絕在訓練受約束模型之前無法識別的實驗。
